en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the son of Adam<sup>as</sup> as hollow’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has created the child of Adam hollow.’”
